units.source_text: 感觉，大概未曾欺骗过我。

en.t: My intuition had probably never deceived me.

units.source_text: 母亲那双细小而狡猾的凹陷的眼睛，仿佛如今才使我领会到我对母亲的厌恶是正当的。

en.t: My mother's small, cunning, sunken eyes seemed only now to make me understand that my hatred of her was justified.

units.source_text: 如前所述，我本来对自己是由这个人产生出来这件事，

en.t: As I have said before, the fact that I had been brought into being by this person

units.source_text: 就感到有一种不耐烦的厌恶，还有一种莫大耻辱的思绪……

en.t: had always filled me with an impatient disgust, and also with a feeling of immense shame...

units.source_text: 这反而使我同母亲绝缘，没有给我报复的余地。

en.t: Yet this instead cut me off from my mother and left me no room for revenge.
And yet the bond had not been undone.
